transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I’ve been having trouble at work. I keep feeling like people there, and some of the vendors, are tracking what I buy and messing with the launch numbers so I look stupid. My supervisor says the reports don’t show that, but I can’t really shake it.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people can't hear?

Yeah… sometimes. Like in the stockroom, or driving back from vendor meetings, I’ll hear a guy behind me saying stuff like, “Move faster, Scott,” or laughing about what I picked. But when I look, there’s nobody there.
Do you ever find it hard to express yourself or get your thoughts across to others in a way that makes sense?
I don’t know… maybe sometimes. I feel like I’m making sense, but people ask me to repeat myself or they just kind of look at me. I’m not sure if that’s me or them.
Do you feel like your thoughts are disconnected or hard to follow when you're trying to explain something?
I’m not really sure. I mean, it feels connected in my head when I’m saying it. Maybe other people don’t follow it, but I don’t… I don’t notice it that way.
Do you often feel like your thoughts are racing or jumping from one idea to another?
I don’t know… maybe sometimes, but I haven’t really noticed it like that. My head just feels busy, I guess.
Do you often have difficulty organizing your thoughts in a logical way?
I’m not sure. I don’t really think about it that way. I just try to explain things, and… if it comes out wrong, I don’t always notice.
Do you feel like you have trouble sticking to one topic when you're talking to someone?
I don’t know… maybe sometimes people say I go off track, but I don’t really catch it when I’m talking.
Do you feel like you're able to clearly express your thoughts and ideas to others?
I mean… I think so, sometimes. I try to explain it, but I’m not always sure if it comes out clear to other people.
Do you feel like your thoughts are disorganized or fragmented?
I’m not really sure. Sometimes it feels kind of jumbled, but I don’t know if I’d call it fragmented. I just… don’t always notice it that way.
Do you believe that people are really tracking what you buy and messing with the launch numbers?

Yeah… I mean, I know it sounds weird. But I can’t really shake it. It feels like people at work, and maybe some vendors, are watching what I buy and messing with the launch numbers so I look stupid. My supervisor showed me reports that don’t really prove it, but… it still feels like that’s what’s happening.
Do you often find yourself using words or phrases that seem to have a special meaning that other people don't understand?
I don’t think so… not on purpose, anyway. I mean, maybe I say things that make sense to me, but I haven’t really noticed people not understanding special meanings or anything.
Do you think these people tracking your purchases and altering launch numbers are out to harm you specifically?

I don’t know if I’d say “harm” me. It feels more like they’re trying to make me look stupid… like messing with my buys or the launch numbers so it comes back on me. I know the reports don’t prove it, but I still can’t shake it.
Do you think the voices you hear and the people tracking your purchases are connected in some way?

I’m not sure. Sometimes it feels like it might be connected… like when I’m in the stockroom or driving back from a vendor, I’ll hear this man’s voice behind me saying stuff like, “Move faster, Scott,” or laughing about my picks. But when I turn around, nobody’s there.
Do you often feel like you're having trouble finding the right words when you're trying to explain something?
I don’t know… maybe sometimes. I’m not great at explaining things, but I don’t think it’s like I can’t find words all the time. It just depends.
Do you often feel like your thoughts are not making sense to you?
Not really... I mean, I get confused sometimes, but I don’t usually think my thoughts don’t make sense. It’s more like I don’t explain them well.
Do you think the way you're explaining your concerns about being tracked makes sense to others?

I mean… I think it makes sense, but people act like it doesn’t. What really got me here is I can’t shake this feeling that people at work, and maybe some vendors, are tracking what I buy and messing with the launch numbers so I look stupid. Even when my supervisor shows me reports that don’t prove it, it still feels like something’s off.
Do you often feel like you jump from one idea to another when talking to someone?
Maybe sometimes, yeah. I don’t really notice it much… I might get sidetracked, but I don’t know if it’s jumping around exactly.
Do you often feel like you're having conversations where your responses seem unrelated to the questions being asked?
I don’t think so. I mean, maybe if I’m distracted I answer weird, but I haven’t really noticed people saying my answers don’t match the question.
Do you still believe that people are tracking your purchases and altering launch numbers?

Yeah… I mean, I still feel like that’s what’s happening. I know my supervisor showed me reports and they don’t really prove it, but I can’t shake it. It still feels like people at work, maybe vendors too, are watching what I buy and messing with the numbers so I look bad.
